source_text: Spera in Domino et fac bonitatem; inhabita terram et pasceris in divitiis eius. Terra haec — cor auditoris, agri animae. Delectare in Domino, et dabit tibi petitiones cordis tui. Revela Domino viam tuam et spera in eum. Educet sicut lumen iustitiam tuam. Gloria Christo. Amen.
pass_a_gloss: Hope in the Lord and do goodness; dwell in the land and you will feed on its riches. This land — the hearer’s heart, the soul’s fields. Delight in the Lord, and he will give you the petitions of your heart. Reveal your way to the Lord and hope in him. He will bring forth your justice like light. Glory to Christ. Amen.
pass_b_english: [[Trust in the Lord and do good; dwell in the land and feed on its faithfulness >> Bible:Psalm 37:3]]. The “land” is the hearer’s heart — till the soul’s field. [[Delight yourself in the Lord, and he will give you the desires of your heart >> Bible:Psalm 37:4]]. [[Commit your way to the Lord >> Bible:Psalm 37:5]]; he will [[bring forth your righteousness as the light >> Bible:Psalm 37:6]]. Glory to Christ. Amen.
